scope: Local standard-library read-only code/schema compatibility audit. No main/publish/driver/finalizer executed, no media read/decode, no SSH/Docker/native/GPU/daemon or Git/source/raw mutation.

current_shared_worker_validator_with_cor.error: Native worker receipts: harness SHA is not bound to the frozen dependency closure

findings.finding: host_path is the legacy live-workspace mapping, not the isolated cohort mapping. /data/matrix.json has no mapping at all; /outputs resolves outside the actual cohort; /workspace sources use live ROOT instead of frozen source.
findings.minimal_adaptation: Add an explicit fresh-cohort contract deriving exact source/inputs/outputs/control mounts from the identity-bound host plan and original launch/inspect receipts. Reject foreign paths, symlinks and traversal. Do not rewrite native JSON or symlink missing paths into the old layout.

findings.finding: The old launch/driver schema requires launcher_sha256/launch_exit_code/image_id and command/harness_sha256/returncode/completion_verified/finished_utc/matrix_sha256. Fresh host/launch-receipt is schema1 with native_argv, host plan identity, driver_returncode, observer_returncode, CPU finalizer result and stopped-owned-CID records. It never emits the old fields. Its native argv invokes /control/run_frozen_matrix.py, not a direct sim2sim_scene_matrix.py token.
findings.minimal_adaptation: Validate the real fresh host receipt in a separate mode, bound to expected host/native plan identities and frozen host/control wrapper SHAs. Require actual completed status, driver0 and after-stop0, observer0, cpu_validation0, both stopped exact CIDs, finished_unix and no cleanup/post errors. Preserve original receipt bytes; do not synthesize a passing legacy receipt.

findings.finding: A correct fresh path translator still fails the currently imported validator because it anchors the harness path to that imported module ROOT. Current imported ROOT is the live repository; fresh harness is under cohort/source.
findings.minimal_adaptation: After checking its frozen dependency/manifest SHA, load the unchanged matrix module from cohort/source so its ROOT is naturally the frozen source. Keep the strict shared worker receipt validator and raw namespace values unchanged; the first real completed case passes this form.

findings.finding: Publisher has no input or validation for the exact 1258 host command_writer birth/namespace mappings, original observer summary or exact own container identity. Native receipt validation proves private container process groups and entry births, not host PID/TID correspondence.
findings.minimal_adaptation: Require the terminal host receipt and observer summary/launch/inspect snapshots. Recheck one mapping for every (case, role, native PID, birth) with entry SHA, unique host thread (TID,birth), NSpid/NStgid endpoints and exact CID/image/StartedAt. Copy these original receipts and bind their SHAs in the publication manifest.

findings.finding: Publisher checks stored ffprobe metadata and PNG header/dimensions only. It neither performs full video decode nor requires the actual CPU full-validation receipt; it therefore does not prove the fresh629 full-decode gate.
findings.minimal_adaptation: Consume host/final-validation/full-validation.json only after completed host receipt binds full_validation_sha256 and CPU exit0. Require passed/629cases/1258workers/629decodes, ordered exact case/result/three-receipt/video SHA+bytes correspondence, full_decode true/returncode0 and exact completed matrix/native plan identities. Preserve the actual ffmpeg command/stderr and original media bytes; do not relabel metadata probing as decoding.

findings.finding: Publisher verifies the native input closure (376 dependencies, 1887 generated triples, 2 models and source matrix), but does not verify the identity-bound 5206-file fresh freeze manifest or host/control/CPU preflight contracts. 5206 is the total frozen source/input/control/evidence-file count, not 5206 distinct motion inputs.
findings.minimal_adaptation: Require expected host-plan identity, freeze_manifest_sha256 and snapshot_files_verified_before/after=5206; independently rehash every safe freeze entry before publication and verify identity-linked CPU-preflight receipt, native plan file and wrappers. Keep expected hashes fixed through copying. Retain the original freeze manifest and complete byte provenance; no need to duplicate all 5206 source bytes into the media gallery if retained source/archive availability is stated.

compatible_reusable_contracts: Explicit expected plan/harness identities are already CLI requirements; native schema3 plan shape and immutable case order accept the actual frozen plan.
Schema3 worker supervisor and three-receipt sealing can be reused unchanged under the correct frozen module ROOT.
Byte-exact copy, sealed historical-attempt checks, threshold preservation, 24-card pagination, CSV/JSON and world-XY gallery remain suitable after a strict fresh-cohort validation stage.
Current rejection is safe. Running matrix/missing terminal observer and CPU final receipts are expected incomplete state, not a fault to bypass.
minimum_tests_for_future_adapter: Actual fresh-schema read-only fixture; reject old schema silently coerced to fresh.
Foreign mount/live ROOT substitution, .. and symlink rejection; correct frozen validator module binding.
Missing/duplicate/reused birth or case/role hostwriter mapping rejects, exact1258 required.
CPU final wrong native plan/matrix/result/worker/video SHA, decode false/nonzero/missing629 rejects.
Freeze manifest or one frozen input/control/current copy tampering rejects; copy retains original expected hashes.
A two-case preview remains explicitly partial and cannot claim1258/629/5206 terminal success.
limitations: Only the first already completed case three-receipt validation was probed, not all currently completed cases.
No full video decode or 5206-byte rehash was performed in this audit. The existing actual automatic finalizer remains responsible for future terminal CPU evidence.
No existing active cohort control/core is changed. A separate reviewed publisher adapter can be developed without disturbing it.
